name: Healing Spiral
effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal(X)** the target, where **X** is the number of enemy models slain by combat attacks as part of that **^^Fight^^** ability.
declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
